question: What runs out before oil?
answer: Possibly phosphorus. There is no substitute for it in fertiliser and no way to synthesise it; economically minable phosphate rock sits in a handful of countries, with a very large share in one disputed territory. Meanwhile a great deal of it is flushed into the sea through sewage.
move: You can invent a new energy source. You cannot invent a new element.
source: USGS phosphate rock; Cordell et al., Global Environmental Change, 2009
